research.title: Sonar Supports OpenAI’s Call for Collective Action on Cyber Defense
research.summary: The window to strengthen cyber defense is narrowing, as advanced AI models compress the time between vulnerability disclosure and exploitation from months to minutes. It’s the responsibility of the defenders to match that pace. That is why we’ve signed.
